pages.text: The Spirit Instrument switches among Exploration, Wrench, Pickaxe, Building and Teleport. It cannot receive random enchanting-table results, but anvils accept the current Netherite Pickaxe enchantment set.
Exploration transfers supported opened containers. Wrench uses public wrench semantics, safely dismantles machines, and links opposite-state ruins of the same type.

Teleport spends one Immortal Yuan to move 1-20 blocks along sight. Hold the rebindable special-action key (grave by default) and scroll to adjust distance. Shift-use air empty-handed in Wrench mode to clear the saved ruin endpoint.
